body:
Agent task runs keep producing test failures, which reviews then file as Tech Debt tasks. This feature gathers the fixes:

- Removing a project and adding it back keeps its tasks (`test_folder_of_projects` sometimes sees none).
- Solace's server stops using about half a processor core while nothing is happening.
- The acceptance tests' time limits hold on a busy machine.
- `task propose` doesn't leave an agent waiting past Claude Code's 30-minute limit.

Measured on WSL2 (16 logical processors, 7.7 GB): with the app closed, the suite takes about 38–40 s, and `test_folder_of_projects` failed in 3 of 5 runs. With the app open it took 47–60 s, with more timing failures. The server used 60% of a core while one planning conversation was waiting.
title: Reliable test runs and an idle server
